title: stemonurus corniculatus
intro: Stemonurus corniculatus, commonly known as the "Bitter Pepper", is a plant species native to tropical regions. This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering potential health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of Stemonurus corniculatus include antioxidant, analgesic, and antipyretic properties, which may aid in relieving pain, reducing fever, and protecting against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
